description: Radxa Cubie A7S (Allwinner A733: 2 Cortex-A76 and 6 Cortex-A55; BXM-4-64 GPU and 3 TOPS NPU), 4 GB LPDDR5 (UNCONFIRMED: the page lists options up to 16 GB). A board record: Atlas flashes it from the A733's FEL download mode, an eGON SPL and U-Boot over USB, and writes the microSD card. The family (allwinner-fel) gives the shared download-mode method and steps. Written from Radxa's docs and the board schematic; untested on this board.

ram.this_record: 4 GB LPDDR5 (UNCONFIRMED: the page's options start above 4 GB)
ram.variants: up to 16 GB (the page gives no list)

network.ethernet: 1x Gigabit through the MAE0621A-Q3C PHY (schematic p18); the RJ45 has an orange link LED and a green activity LED

ports: USB-C 2: USB 3.2 with DisplayPort Alt Mode, and OTG

camera.connectors: one 4-lane MIPI camera connector (type and pinout UNCONFIRMED)

storage_target_evidence: docs.radxa.com Cubie A7S: one microSD (TF) slot; an eMMC is optional (up to 256 GB) and its footprint is unpopulated by default.
Atlas writes the microSD card (the SD target). The A7S's SPI NOR is not stated (UNCONFIRMED), and Atlas does not write it.
instructions: Hold the USB BOOT button before power-on, and connect a USB-C port of the board to this computer with a data cable (which port is UNCONFIRMED: see todo).
Power the board on, then release the USB BOOT button.
The board appears as 1f3a:efe8 (Allwinner FEL). Atlas loads the SPL and U-Boot over FEL, writes the image to the microSD card, reads it back and restarts the board.

flash.fel_image: eGON SPL then legacy U-Boot (u-boot-sunxi-with-spl form), UNCONFIRMED for the A733

todo: Sources: the USB BOOT button is held before power-on (docs.radxa.com/en/cubie/a7s hardware info). The 1f3a:efe8 id is the same A733 FEL id as the A7A record (Radxa's PhoenixSuit driver docs, sunxi-tools fel_lib.h). UNCONFIRMED until lsusb on the board shows it.

UNCONFIRMED: which of the two USB-C ports is the FEL port (USB-C 1, USB 2.0 with power and OTG, or USB-C 2, USB 3.2 with DP Alt Mode and OTG), and the PC cable steps. Radxa's A7S hardware page says only that the USB BOOT button is held before power-on.

UNCONFIRMED: the loader glob u-boot-sunxi-with-spl*.bin, and the A7S's FEL image (Radxa's images are Android 13 zips from github.com/radxa/allwinner-android-manifests, not downloaded). Gaia needs: the A733 FEL image (eGON SPL and U-Boot) as the loader, and the microSD disk image.
UNCONFIRMED: the 4 GB RAM size (the page lists up to 16 GB).
UNCONFIRMED: the LEDs' GPIO pins and polarity (LED2 green on LED_G_EN; LED1 blue from PJ26_LED_B).
UNCONFIRMED: the 4-lane camera connector's type and pinout, and whether an SPI NOR is fitted.
The eMMC is optional and unpopulated by default, so the microSD is the storage target. Running, the board needs a Gaia image with board-lite; no Gaia board config for the Cubie exists yet.
